name: Berkeley Energia Limited
summary: Berkeley Energia Limited engages in the exploration and development of mineral properties in Spain. The company explores uranium, lithium, rubidium, tin, tantalum, niobium, tungsten, cobalt, antimony, and other battery and critical metals. It primarily holds interest in the Salamanca Uranium project located in Western Spain. The company also has interests in the Conchas Project, which covers an area of 31 square kilometers located in the western part of the Salamanca province; and the Oliva and La Majada projects which consist of two tenements located in Spain.
